title: Welcome! Add your first space
description:
👋 **Welcome to Ticketrail!**

This board belongs to Ticketrail itself, so **don't put your work here**. Give each of your projects its own **space** and its own board, which takes about two minutes:

1. **Open the space menu.** Click the project name at the top left of the board.
2. Click **Configure spaces** at the bottom of that menu.
3. Click **Add space** and pick your project's folder. If you'd rather type it, click *or type a path*.
4. Press **copy** next to the line that appears under your new space.
5. Open a **new Terminal window**, paste that line, and press Enter. Claude starts. Then type `/ticketrail-work` and press Enter. Leave this window open.
6. Back on the board, pick your new space in the project menu. The dot at the top right should read **worker ready**. Now write your first card in **Backlog** and drag it to **Plan** or **Implement**.

💡 Each space needs its own Claude window (step 5). The board itself serves all of them.

📖 The README's *friendly guide* walks through all of this with screenshots.
